scheme_name: Supporting Community Radio Movement in India
other_conditions: Must be explicitly constituted as a non‑profit organisation
Must have a proven record of at least three years of service to the local community
Must be a legal entity registered under the Societies Act or any other relevant act
Must be an NGO, registered society or public charitable trust registered on NITI Aayog's NGO Darpan portal and provide its Unique ID
The community radio station to be operated must serve a specific well‑defined local community with ownership and management reflective of that community
Programme content must be relevant to the educational, developmental, social and cultural needs of the community
benefits_summary: Financial assistance is provided once the community radio station becomes operational.
documents_required: Registration certificate under the Societies Act or relevant act
